llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究SLM成形Ti-6Al-4V的粉末重复使用对机械性能的影响，属于L1层核心关注点。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not include fatigue testing or S-N curve data, focusing instead on static mechanical properties and forming characteristics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究粉末重复使用对SLM成形Ti-6Al-4V成形特性和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验制备不同重复使用次数的粉末并进行SLM成形，测试力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 粉末重复使用会影响成形件密度、显微组织和拉伸性能。
summary_zh.validation: 采用拉伸试验和显微组织观察进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of powder reuse on the forming characteristics and mechanical properties of SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Experimental SLM with powders reused for different cycles, followed by mechanical testing and microstructural analysis.
summary_en.result: Powder reuse alters densification, microstructure, and tensile properties of the SLM parts.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical characterization (tensile tests) and microstructural observation.

papers.title: Mechanobiological evaluation of solid and multiple porous humeral stem architectures in reverse shoulder arthroplasty based on design and materials: a finite element study
papers.abstract: Introduction: Stress shielding is a major cause of radiological changes in the humeral component, which is commonly evident in cementless stems of reverse shoulder implants. The bulkiness of the humeral stem results in less load being transmitted to the bone, curtailing bone remodeling. Designing an implant with adequate strength and a suitable material that matches the mechanical properties of bone can help prevent the implant migration or loosening, thereby lowering bone resorption. Methods: Humeral stems with no porosity and varied porosities, such as circular, elliptical, and trabecular architecture, were designed using 316L stainless steel and titanium alloy (Ti6Al4V). Finite element analysis (FEA) was conducted on eight bone-implant assemblies under four loading conditions for cortical and trabecular bones. Weighted mean of von Mises stress and mechanobiology associated with the strain energy densities were studied. This serves as a precursor in predicting the effect of stress shielding. Results: The titanium implant with trabecular architecture was mechanically close to the intact bone compared to the other varied porosity designs. It also had better load-bearing capacity than the solid stems. Discussion: These investigations help understand the load-bearing capacity of reverse shoulder humeral stems and ascertain the importance of combining the design and material in enhancing implant stability and longevity.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是反向肩关节置换术中的肱骨柄，而非指定的股骨/髋关节柄，解剖部位不符。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on humeral stems for reverse shoulder arthroplasty, not femoral/hip stems as required by the direction; anatomical mismatch makes it non-comparable.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同多孔肱骨柄设计对减少应力遮挡的效果
summary_zh.method: 对四种孔型（无孔、圆孔、椭圆孔、小梁孔）的316L和Ti6Al4V肱骨柄进行有限元分析
summary_zh.result: 钛合金小梁结构柄的力学性能最接近完整骨骼，承载能力优于实心柄
summary_zh.validation: 仅有限元仿真，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate how different porous humeral stem designs can reduce stress shielding in reverse shoulder arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Finite element analysis was conducted on eight bone-implant assemblies with varying stem porosities (solid, circular, elliptical, trabecular) made of 316L stainless steel and Ti6Al4V under four loading conditions.
summary_en.result: The Ti6Al4V stem with trabecular architecture showed mechanical properties closest to intact bone and better load-bearing capacity than solid stems.
summary_en.validation: The study is simulation-based with no experimental validation.
